confirmCost: I confirm the quoted desktop cost and deadline.
executionDisabled: Acceptance is unavailable until this configuration's qualification and acceptance switch are effective.
localOnly: Start acceptance on the owning desktop Host. Remote-Host child bindings are unavailable.
quoteExpired: The estimate expired. Prepare a new proposal and confirm its cost.
cancelDescription: The Host will end the delegation and destroy the desktop. Saved evidence remains in the results.
sourceMissing: The source conversation is no longer available locally. This acceptance was cancelled.
runFailed: The acceptance could not be started or attached. Any known started run was cancelled; refresh status before retrying.
cancelFailed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. Refresh this run and cancel again to confirm desktop cleanup.
statusFailed: Acceptance status could not be refreshed. Check the owning Host.
proposalUnavailable: The proposed delivery could not be loaded. Refresh eligible deliveries.

criteria.invalid: Enter 1–50 non-empty criteria, each no longer than 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
